method: AST. Module-level path constants are followed; paths built at runtime are recorded as UNRESOLVED with their source expression, never guessed and never omitted.

step_gap.note: A step with zero resolvable inputs is where core/notary.py's _age_state() sees an empty list and returns FULL trust. The count is the size of that fail-open surface.

unresolved.expr: TMP / [lf for lf in S._read_leaves(S.LEAVES) if lf['id'] == new_id][0]['path']
